links.comparator_used: Pre-AI period (standard reading order without AI triage prioritization) for PE-positive CTPA examinations
links.outcome: Report turnaround time (scan completion to first preliminary report) for PE-positive CTPA
links.effect: Work hours: mean TAT 68.9 min pre-AI vs 46.7 min post-AI, time savings 22.2 min (95% CI 5.85-38.6; P = .004). Off-hours: 44.8 vs 42.0 min, savings 2.82 min (-11.1 to 16.7; P = .345), not significant. Model predicted 29.6 min (work hours) and 2.10 min (off-hours).
links.quote: Clinically observed time savings during work hours (22.2 [95% confidence interval: 5.85-38.6] min) were significant (P = .004), while off-hour (2.82 [-11.1 to 16.7] min) were not (P = .345).

design_hint: AI triage prioritization of worklist (pre/post deployment comparison)
